# ACE ACOUSTICS

> ACE ACOUSTICS® (ACEMACAN FZ LLC) is a Dubai-based supplier of acoustic ceilings, acoustic wall panels, acoustic baffles and clouds, seamless acoustic plaster and soundproofing systems for the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman). It is the exclusive GCC partner of DEGO Ceiling (China) and DAIKEN Corporation (Japan).

Contact: info@ace-acoustics.com · +971-505-769-237 · Office No. 102, RKM Building, 28th Street, Hor Al Anz East, Dubai, UAE

## Solutions
- [Acoustic ceiling tiles](https://ace-acoustics.com/acoustic-ceiling/): DEGOFON stonewool (A1) and fiberglass (A2) tiles, DAIKEN EXCELTONE mineral fiber, DEGOTONE perforated gypsum
- [Acoustic wall panels](https://ace-acoustics.com/acoustic-wall-panels/): fabric-wrapped, aluminium-frame fabric, DEGOTONE WALL and DAIKEN panels
- [Acoustic baffles and clouds](https://ace-acoustics.com/acoustic-baffles/): fiberglass baffles (NRC 0.85) and a PET vs fiberglass comparison
- [Seamless acoustic plaster](https://ace-acoustics.com/acoustic-plaster/): DegoSilent systems, NRC up to 1.05
- [Soundproofing](https://ace-acoustics.com/soundproofing/): DAIKEN soundproof doors, partition cores, anti-vibration flooring
- [Arabic](https://ace-acoustics.com/ar/)
